name: WS Cookie Consent Light
author: websolutionnetwork

sections.description:
WS Cookie Consent Light is a simple, lightweight, and fully customizable GDPR cookie consent plugin.
Easily display a cookie consent banner with customizable colors, text, and position.
You can link to your privacy policy page and optionally display your brand credit (“Powered by Web Solution Network”).

Features:
* Lightweight and fast
* Fully customizable colors and text
* Top or bottom banner position
* Link to your Privacy Policy page
* Optional “Powered by” branding
* Simple admin settings page
* Compatible with all modern browsers
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ws-cookie-consent-light-by-web-solution-network/ directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → WS Cookie Consent to configure the plugin.
  4. Customize your banner message, colors, and link to your privacy policy page.
  5. Save changes and enjoy your compliant, user-friendly cookie consent banner.
sections.faq:
How do I change the banner text or colors?

Go to Settings → WS Cookie Consent, where you can edit all banner options.

Can I change the position of the banner?

Yes, you can choose between top and bottom positions.

Can I disable the “Powered by Web Solution Network” text?

Yes, you can disable it easily from the plugin settings.

Does this plugin use cookies?

Yes, it sets a simple cookie to remember the user’s consent status (accepted/rejected).
